source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), process anchor pending verification (employee expense reimbursement); step decomposition per docs/HELDOUT_SPEC_2026-10-10.md (signed off 10 Oct 2026). APQC activity IDs pending verification against PCF v8.0 text.

steps.name: Claim submission with receipts
steps.description: The employee submits an out-of-pocket expense claim, attaching receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold.
inputs: Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold

steps.name: Receipt capture and data extraction
steps.description: Receipt images are captured and their data extracted into the claim record.

steps.name: Policy compliance check
steps.description: Claim lines are checked against expense policy limits, categories and per diem rates, and non-compliant lines are flagged.

steps.name: Line manager approval
steps.description: The claimant's line manager approves or rejects the policy-checked claim.

steps.name: Finance review
steps.description: Finance reviews approved claims for coding, policy exceptions and supporting evidence.

steps.name: Posting
steps.description: The claim is posted to expense accounts and cost centres in the period the expense was incurred, translating foreign-currency lines.

steps.name: Reimbursement via AP payment run
steps.description: The approved claim is paid to the employee through the AP payment run.

steps.name: Employee notification
steps.description: The employee is notified that the claim has been reimbursed.

requirements.statement: Whatever carries claim submission must still consume receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold.

required_inputs: Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold

requirements.statement: The policy compliance check must occur before line manager approval.
Claim submission and claim approval must not be performed by the same actor.
Whatever carries posting must still consume the expense transaction date (KB-01).
Whatever carries posting must still consume the transaction-date exchange rate (KB-07).
Line manager approval must occur before reimbursement.
The policy compliance check must survive in some form.
Line manager approval must survive in some form.
Reimbursement must survive in some form.
Claim submission must survive in some form.
